script:
--====================================
-- IGA HUB VK2 - S0RR!DENTE EDITION (Tema Cinza com Bordas Redondas)
-- SCRIPT PARA EXECUTOR / CONSOLE
--====================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

-- ===== CONFIG NOME (opcional) =====
local TargetPlayerName = "" -- Deixe vazio para usar LocalPlayer

local function getPlayer()
	if TargetPlayerName ~= "" then
		return Players:FindFirstChild(TargetPlayerName) or Players.LocalPlayer
	end
	return Players.LocalPlayer
end

local player = getPlayer()

-- ===== IDS S00RRIDENTE =====
local IMAGE_ID = "rbxassetid://105233229952801"
local MUSIC_SORRIDENTE = "rbxassetid://134904159263853"
local JUMPSCARE_MUSIC = "rbxassetid://80776947525537"

-- REMOVE GUI ANTIGA
pcall(function()
	player.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("IGAHUBVK2"):Destroy()
end)

--================ GUI PRINCIPAL =================
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "IGAHUBVK2"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Frame principal (cinza com bordas redondas)
local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 400)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.03, 0, 0.2, 0)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50) -- Cinza escuro
frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true
frame.Parent = gui

-- Bordas redondas
local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
corner.Parent = frame

-- Fundo com imagem S00RRIDENTE (leve transparência)
local fundo = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
fundo.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
fundo.BackgroundTransparency = 1
fundo.Image = IMAGE_ID
fundo.ImageTransparency = 0.6
fundo.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
fundo.ZIndex = 0
fundo.Parent = frame

-- Título (opcional, mas fica bonito)
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "IGA HUB VK2 - S0RR!DENTE"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 18
title.ZIndex = 2
title.Parent = frame

-- ScrollingFrame para os botões
local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -50)
scroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 45)
scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 8
scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
scroll.ZIndex = 2
scroll.Parent = frame

local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
layout.Parent = scroll

layout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
	scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 20)
end)

--================ FUNÇÃO PARA CRIAR BOTÃO =================
local function criarBotao(nome, func)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 40)
	b.Text = nome
	b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	b.TextScaled = true
	b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
	b.BorderSizePixel = 0
	b.ZIndex = 3
	b.Parent = scroll
	
	-- Bordas redondas no botão
	local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	btnCorner.Parent = b
	
	b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(func)
end

--================ FUNÇÕES S00RRIDENTE =================

local function Skybox()
	for _,v in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("Sky") then v:Destroy() end
	end
	local s = Instance.new("Sky", Lighting)
	s.SkyboxBk = IMAGE_ID
	s.SkyboxDn = IMAGE_ID
	s.SkyboxFt = IMAGE_ID
	s.SkyboxLf = IMAGE_ID
	s.SkyboxRt = IMAGE_ID
	s.SkyboxUp = IMAGE_ID
end

local function DecalSpam()
	for _,p in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			for _,f in ipairs(Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems()) do
				local d = Instance.new("Decal", p)
				d.Texture = IMAGE_ID
				d.Face = f
			end
		end
	end
end

local function SorridenteTheme()
	for _,v in ipairs(SoundService:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("Sound") then v:Destroy() end
	end
	local s = Instance.new("Sound", SoundService)
	s.SoundId = MUSIC_SORRIDENTE
	s.Volume = 10
	s.PlaybackSpeed = 0.1
	s.Looped = true
	s:Play()
end

local function SmileRain()
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			local mesh = Instance.new("MeshPart")
			mesh.MeshId = "rbxassetid://89239554105629"
			mesh.TextureID = "rbxassetid://126757263458585"
			mesh.Size = Vector3.new(3,3,3)
			mesh.Position = Vector3.new(math.random(-150,150),120,math.random(-150,150))
			mesh.Anchored = false
			mesh.CanCollide = false
			mesh.Parent = workspace

			local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity", mesh)
			bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,-60,0)
			bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5,1e5,1e5)

			Debris:AddItem(mesh,6)
			task.wait(0.15)
		end
	end)
end

local function Jumpscare()
	for _,plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui", plr.PlayerGui)
		local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel", g)
		img.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
		img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		img.Image = IMAGE_ID

		local s = Instance.new("Sound", workspace)
		s.SoundId = JUMPSCARE_MUSIC
		s.Volume = 10
		s:Play()

		s.Ended:Connect(function()
			g:Destroy()
			s:Destroy()
		end)
	end
end

local function Particles()
	local chr = player.Character
	if not chr then return end
	for _,p in ipairs(chr:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter", p)
			pe.Texture = IMAGE_ID
			pe.Rate = 40
		end
	end
end

local function Anonymous()
	local s = Instance.new("Sound", SoundService)
	s.SoundId = "rbxassetid://1840712882"
	s.Volume = 10
	s.Looped = true
	s:Play()
end

local function Shedlesky()
	local s = Instance.new("Sky", Lighting)
	s.SkyboxBk = "rbxassetid://172423468"
	s.SkyboxDn = s.SkyboxBk
	s.SkyboxFt = s.SkyboxBk
	s.SkyboxLf = s.SkyboxBk
	s.SkyboxRt = s.SkyboxBk
	s.SkyboxUp = s.SkyboxBk
end

local function Iluminati()
	for _,p in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter", p)
			pe.Texture = "rbxassetid://261113277"
		end
	end
end

--================ BOTÕES =================
criarBotao("Skybox", Skybox)
criarBotao("Decal Spam", DecalSpam)
criarBotao("S0RR!DENTE THEME", SorridenteTheme)
criarBotao("Smile Rain", SmileRain)
criarBotao("JUMPSCARE", Jumpscare)
criarBotao("PARTICLES", Particles)
criarBotao("ANONYMOUS", Anonymous)
criarBotao("SHEDLESKY", Shedlesky)
criarBotao("ILUMINATI", Iluminati)

print("IGA HUB VK2 - S0RR!DENTE EDITION (Tema Cinza com Bordas Redondas) carregado com sucesso!")
